<!-- The route picker, map, elevation profile, GPX, share and image, for the
ROTD and Bikes pages. Needs _common.qmd and _route-helpers.qmd, and a PICKER
cell on the page: ({file, km: [min, max], defaultKm: [low, high], share,
list: link to this library on the Routes page}) -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// A route opened from a link (?route=<key>, from a share or the Routes list)
// shows until you change a setting; the controls start out including it.
sharedKey = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("route")
fromList = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("from") === "list"
sharedRoute = routes.features.find((f) => f.properties.key === sharedKey) ?? null
DEFAULT_TYPES = sharedRoute?.properties.type === "out-and-back" ? ["Out-and-back"] : ["Loop"]
DEFAULT_KM = sharedRoute
  ? [Math.min(PICKER.defaultKm[0], Math.floor(sharedRoute.properties.km)),
     Math.max(PICKER.defaultKm[1], Math.ceil(sharedRoute.properties.km))]
  : PICKER.defaultKm

viewof types = Inputs.checkbox(["Loop", "Out-and-back"], {
  label: "Route type",
  value: DEFAULT_TYPES
})
viewof km = rangeSlider({min: PICKER.km[0], max: PICKER.km[1], step: 0.5, value: DEFAULT_KM, label: "Distance"})
viewof again = Inputs.button("Another route")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
routes = d3.json(PICKER.file) // FileAttachment only takes a literal name

matching = routes.features.filter(
  (f) =>
    types.map((t) => t.toLowerCase()).includes(f.properties.type) &&
    f.properties.km >= km[0] &&
    f.properties.km <= km[1]
)

// Today in Vancouver, as YYYY-MM-DD: the seed for the route of the day.
today = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", {timeZone: "America/Vancouver"})

// FNV-1a string hash: turns the date into a number, the same on every phone.
function hash(text) {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (const c of text) h = Math.imul(h ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return h >>> 0;
}

// mulberry32: random numbers from a seed. Same seed, same sequence, anywhere.
function seeded(seed) {
  return () => {
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// Today's order for the matching routes: a Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded by the
// date. Everyone gets the same order; "Another route" steps along it, so no
// route repeats until you've seen them all.
order = {
  const random = seeded(hash(today));
  const idx = matching.map((_, i) => i);
  for (let i = idx.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [idx[i], idx[j]] = [idx[j], idx[i]];
  }
  return idx;
}

useShared =
  sharedRoute !== null &&
  again === 0 &&
  types.join() === DEFAULT_TYPES.join() &&
  km.join() === DEFAULT_KM.join()

position = matching.length ? again % matching.length : 0

route = useShared
  ? sharedRoute
  : matching.length
    ? matching[order[position]]
    : null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
route
  ? html`<div class="route-card">
      <h3>${route.properties.name}</h3>
      <p class="route-stats">
        <strong>${route.properties.km.toFixed(1)} km</strong> ${route.properties.type} ·
        <strong>↑ ${route.properties.gain_m} m ↓ ${route.properties.loss_m} m</strong> ·
        ${route.properties.trail_pct}% trail · ${route.properties.street_pct}% street
        <span class="route-id">· route ${route.properties.id} ·
        ${useShared
          ? html`${fromList ? "from the route list" : "shared with you"} ·
                 <a href=${PICKER.list}>all routes</a>`
          : `${again === 0 ? "route of the day" : "another route"}: ${position + 1} of ${matching.length} matching routes`}</span>
      </p>
      ${sharedKey && !sharedRoute
        ? html`<p class="route-note">The shared route isn't in the current list
            (routes are rebuilt when the trail data changes), so here's today's route.</p>`
        : ""}
    </div>`
  : html`<p><em>No routes match. Widen the distance or tick another route type.</em></p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
map = {
  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: mapDiv,
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron",
    center: START,
    zoom: 13.5,
    attributionControl: {
      customAttribution: "Trails © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)"
    }
  });
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");
  await new Promise((resolve) => m.on("load", resolve));
  m.addSource("route", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  m.addSource("hover", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  m.addSource("labels", {type: "geojson", data: labels});
  m.addSource("route-names", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  const round = {"line-join": "round", "line-cap": "round"};
  // Every named trail, faintly, so you can see what the route passes.
  m.addLayer({id: "trails", type: "line", source: "labels",
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"], layout: round,
              paint: {"line-color": "#6b8f71", "line-opacity": 0.8,
                      "line-width": ["interpolate", ["linear"], ["zoom"], 12, 0.8, 16, 2]}});
  m.addLayer({id: "route-casing", type: "line", source: "route", layout: round,
              paint: {"line-color": "#fcfcfb", "line-width": 8}});
  m.addLayer({id: "route", type: "line", source: "route", layout: round,
              paint: {"line-color": "#2a78d6", "line-width": 4}});
  // Arrows along the line show which way to run.
  m.addLayer({id: "route-arrows", type: "symbol", source: "route",
              layout: {"symbol-placement": "line", "symbol-spacing": 80,
                       "text-field": "›", "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"],
                       "text-size": 22, "text-keep-upright": false,
                       "text-allow-overlap": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  // Names along the lines, for everything the route doesn't use; the route's
  // own trails are named on the route itself (next layer, filled in below).
  const along = (size, font) => ({
    "symbol-placement": "line", "text-field": ["get", "name"], "text-font": [font],
    "text-size": size, "text-max-angle": 45, "symbol-spacing": 250
  });
  const halo = {"text-halo-color": "#fcfcfb", "text-halo-width": 1.5};
  m.addLayer({id: "street-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 13,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "street"],
              layout: along(10.5, "Noto Sans Regular"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#52514e", ...halo}});
  m.addLayer({id: "trail-labels", type: "symbol", source: "labels", minzoom: 12.5,
              filter: ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"],
              layout: along(11, "Noto Sans Italic"),
              paint: {"text-color": "#3d6b47", ...halo}});
  m.addLayer({id: "route-names", type: "symbol", source: "route-names",
              layout: {"text-field": ["get", "name"], "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"],
                       "text-size": 12, "text-variable-anchor": ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"],
                       "text-radial-offset": 0.6},
              paint: {"text-color": "#1c5cab", "text-halo-color": "#fcfcfb", "text-halo-width": 2}});
  amenity.addToMap(m, maplibregl, amenitySites);
  // Where the pointer is on the elevation profile.
  m.addLayer({id: "hover", type: "circle", source: "hover",
              paint: {"circle-radius": 7, "circle-color": "#eb6834",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#fcfcfb", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  new maplibregl.Marker({color: "#0b0b0b"})
    .setLngLat(START)
    .setPopup(new maplibregl.Popup().setText("Start and finish: Park Centre"))
    .addTo(m);
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Draw the chosen route and zoom to it.
{
  map.getSource("route").setData(route ?? EMPTY);
  // Name the route's stretches on the route: a bold label halfway along each
  // named stretch of 300 m or more, from the cue sheet.
  const cues = route ? route.properties.cues : [];
  const profile = route ? route.properties.profile : []; // [km, m, lon, lat] every 50 m
  const nearest = (km) => profile.reduce((a, b) => (Math.abs(b[0] - km) < Math.abs(a[0] - km) ? b : a));
  const unnamed = new Set(["unnamed trail", "crossing", "path", "sidewalk", "street"]);
  const named = cues.filter(
    ([label, , km]) => km >= 0.3 && !unnamed.has(label) && !label.startsWith("Cross ")
  );
  map.getSource("route-names").setData({
    type: "FeatureCollection",
    features: named
      .map(([label, at, km]) => {
        const [, , lon, lat] = nearest(at + km / 2);
        return {type: "Feature", properties: {name: label},
                geometry: {type: "Point", coordinates: [lon, lat]}};
      })
  });
  // Trails named on the route drop their faint label; everything else keeps it
  // (either spelling: "Salish Trail" = "Salish").
  const keys = [...new Set(named.map(([label]) => label.replace(/ Trail$/, "")))];
  const onRoute = ["in", ["get", "key"], ["literal", keys]];
  map.setFilter("trail-labels", ["all", ["==", ["get", "kind"], "trail"], ["!", onRoute]]);
  map.setFilter("street-labels", ["all", ["==", ["get", "kind"], "street"], ["!", onRoute]]);
  if (route) {
    const bounds = new maplibregl.LngLatBounds();
    route.geometry.coordinates.forEach((c) => bounds.extend(c));
    map.fitBounds(bounds, {padding: 40, duration: 500});
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
  return Plot.plot({
    width, // the page column, same as the map
    height: 170,
    marginLeft: 44,
    style: {fontSize: "12px"},
    x: {label: "km →", domain: [0, route.properties.km]},
    y: {label: "↑ elevation (m)", domain: [low, route.properties.high_m + (passed.length ? 20 : 5)], grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(profile, {x: "km", y1: low, y2: "m", fill: "#2a78d6", fillOpacity: 0.12}),
      Plot.lineY(profile, {x: "km", y: "m", stroke: "#2a78d6", strokeWidth: 2}),
      ...amenity.profileMarks(Plot, passed),
      Plot.ruleX(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", stroke: "#52514e"})),
      Plot.dot(profile, Plot.pointerX({x: "km", y: "m", fill: "#eb6834", r: 4})),
      Plot.tip(profile, Plot.pointerX({
        x: "km", y: "m",
        title: (d) => [`${d.km.toFixed(1)} km · ${Math.round(d.m)} m`,
                       ...amenity.passedNear(route.properties.passes_by, d.km)].join(" · ")
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function gpx(f) {
  const points = f.geometry.coordinates
    .map(([lon, lat]) => `<trkpt lat="${lat}" lon="${lon}"></trkpt>`)
    .join("\n      ");
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="psp-trails" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">
  <trk>
    <name>PSP ${f.properties.id}: ${f.properties.name} (${f.properties.km} km)</name>
    <trkseg>
      ${points}
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>`;
}

// Phones and tablets get the share sheet. Desktop browsers either have none
// or refuse (Chrome on a Mac: "Permission denied"), so there we copy or download.
touch = matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches

async function shareSheet(data) {
  if (!touch || !navigator.canShare?.(data)) return "unavailable";
  try {
    await navigator.share(data);
    return "shared";
  } catch (e) {
    return e.name === "AbortError" ? "cancelled" : "failed";
  }
}

// Save an image: to the share sheet (Photos, Strava, ...) or as a download.
async function saveImage(blob, name, title) {
  const result = await shareSheet({files: [new File([blob], name, {type: "image/png"})], title});
  if (result === "shared" || result === "cancelled") return;
  const a = Object.assign(document.createElement("a"), {href: URL.createObjectURL(blob), download: name});
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 1000);
}

// Share: the phone's share sheet (messages, WhatsApp, email, Strava, ...).
// The text has a link that opens this exact route; the GPX goes along where
// the phone allows files. Otherwise the text goes to the clipboard.
async function shareRoute(f) {
  const p = f.properties;
  const link = `${location.origin}${location.pathname}?route=${p.key}`;
  const text = [
    `${p.name}: ${p.km.toFixed(1)} km ${p.type}, ↑${p.gain_m} m ↓${p.loss_m} m,`,
    "from the Park Centre (Cleveland Trail & W 16th Ave)",
    link,
    "",
    ...p.directions.map(([at, full]) => `${at.toFixed(1)} km  ${full}`)
  ].join("\n");
  const title = `Pacific Spirit run: ${p.name}`;
  const file = new File([gpx(f)], `psp-${p.id}.gpx`, {type: "application/gpx+xml"});
  let result = await shareSheet({title, text, files: [file]});
  if (result === "unavailable") result = await shareSheet({title, text});
  if (result === "shared" || result === "cancelled") return result;
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  return "copied";
}

function shareButton(f) {
  const label = touch ? "Share" : "Copy link";
  const button = html`<button class="btn btn-quarto" type="button"
    title="The route's link, stats and directions, to paste into a message">${label}</button>`;
  button.onclick = async () => {
    const note = {copied: "Copied ✓", failed: "Couldn't copy"}[
      await shareRoute(f).catch(() => "failed")
    ];
    if (note) {
      button.textContent = note;
      setTimeout(() => (button.textContent = label), 2000);
    }
  };
  return button;
}

// Image: the route as a picture for Strava, Instagram or the group chat.
// 1080 x 1350 (4:5 portrait): the map as shown, name, stats, elevation, the
// trails in order, and credits.
async function routeImage(f) {
  const p = f.properties;
  const W = 1080, H = 1350, pad = 48;
  const font = (weight, size) => `${weight} ${size}px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`;
  const canvas = Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), {width: W, height: H});
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fcfcfb";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // The map, read straight after it draws (cover-fit into the top of the image).
  const snapshot = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    map.once("render", () => resolve(map.getCanvas().toDataURL("image/png")));
    map.triggerRepaint();
  });
  const img = new Image();
  await new Promise((resolve) => { img.onload = resolve; img.src = snapshot; });
  const mapH = 760, scale = Math.max(W / img.width, mapH / img.height);
  const [sw, sh] = [W / scale, mapH / scale];
  ctx.drawImage(img, (img.width - sw) / 2, (img.height - sh) / 2, sw, sh, 0, 0, W, mapH);

  // Name (shrunk to fit), stats and start.
  let y = mapH + 70, size = 52;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b0b0b";
  do { ctx.font = font(700, size); size -= 2; } while (ctx.measureText(p.name).width > W - 2 * pad);
  ctx.fillText(p.name, pad, y);
  ctx.font = font(600, 32);
  ctx.fillText(`${p.km.toFixed(1)} km ${p.type} · ↑${p.gain_m} m ↓${p.loss_m} m · ${p.trail_pct}% trail`, pad, y += 52);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#52514e";
  ctx.font = font(400, 24);
  ctx.fillText("Start/finish: Park Centre, Cleveland Trail & W 16th Ave · Pacific Spirit Regional Park", pad, y += 40);

  // Elevation line.
  const prof = p.profile, top = y + 24, h = 90;
  const [lo, hi] = [d3.min(prof, (d) => d[1]), d3.max(prof, (d) => d[1])];
  const px = (km) => pad + (km / p.km) * (W - 2 * pad);
  const py = (m) => top + h - ((m - lo) / Math.max(hi - lo, 1)) * h;
  ctx.beginPath();
  prof.forEach(([km, m], i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(px(km), py(m)) : ctx.moveTo(px(km), py(m))));
  ctx.lineTo(px(p.km), top + h); ctx.lineTo(px(0), top + h); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(42, 120, 214, 0.15)"; ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  prof.forEach(([km, m], i) => (i ? ctx.lineTo(px(km), py(m)) : ctx.moveTo(px(km), py(m))));
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#2a78d6"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();

  // The trails, in running order.
  const unnamed = new Set(["unnamed trail", "crossing", "path", "sidewalk", "street"]);
  const trails = p.cues.map(([label]) => label.replace(/ Trail$/, ""))
    .filter((t, i, all) => !unnamed.has(t) && !t.startsWith("Cross ") && t !== all[i - 1]);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b0b0b";
  ctx.font = font(500, 26);
  let line = "", ty = top + h + 56;
  for (const word of trails.join(" › ").split(" ")) {
    if (ctx.measureText(`${line} ${word}`).width > W - 2 * pad && line) {
      ctx.fillText(line, pad, ty); ty += 36; line = word;
    } else line = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;
    if (ty > H - 90) break;
  }
  if (ty <= H - 90) ctx.fillText(line, pad, ty);

  // Footer.
  ctx.fillStyle = "#52514e";
  ctx.font = font(400, 20);
  ctx.fillText(`pstrunners.github.io · route ${p.id}`, pad, H - 32);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Map © OpenStreetMap contributors · OpenFreeMap", W - pad, H - 32);
  return new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/png"));
}

function imageButton(f) {
  const button = html`<button class="btn btn-quarto" type="button">Image</button>`;
  button.onclick = async () =>
    saveImage(await routeImage(f), `psp-${f.properties.id}.png`, f.properties.name);
  return button;
}

route
  ? html`<div class="route-actions">
      ${DOM.download(
        () => new Blob([gpx(route)], {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
        `psp-${route.properties.id}.gpx`,
        "Download GPX"
      )}
      ${PICKER.share ? shareButton(route) : ""}
      ${imageButton(route)}
    </div>`
  : html``
```
